rules.statement: A mortgagee cannot claim, in reconvention, a hypothecary decree against a plaintiff who was not a party to the original action.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think it was competent for the first defendant in this case to claim in reconvention for a decree to have the property liable to be sold in execution of his decree as against the plaintiff in this case who was not a party to the Court of Requests case."
